Periodized 6-Week Program 🦉

Your major submission: a real program you'll run and log. Build on your Segment 1 plan. Four parts.

1.Goal + one balanced week. State your goal, then lay out a 7-day week covering cardio, strength, and flexibility (with FITT) and a rest day.

Ethics & Leadership Scenario Set 🦉

Your major submission: reason through three tough situations, then show your skills in one short recorded role-play. Two parts.

A.Three written responses. For each scenario below, state your call and defend it — what values you weighed and why. There's no single "right" answer; your reasoning is what's graded.
① A teammate is bending the rules to win and asks you to go along. What do you do?
② You're in a conflict with a teammate who feels disrespected. Walk through how you'd resolve it (use the 4 steps).
③ Your group has no captain and is falling apart. How do you lead without a title?
B.One recorded role-play (1–2 min). Act out (or narrate) how you'd handle one of the scenarios out loud — the actual words you'd say. Then add a sentence on why you chose that approach.
No camera? No problem. You can record audio only, or write out the role-play as a script with stage directions. The skill is what matters, not the production.
📤 Submit below: type your three responses, and upload or record your role-play (video, audio, or script).

Whatever burns the most calories per minute

Because variety is required to pass

Compare it to no other activity

Do all activities at the exact same time

Choose one brutal activity and nothing else
